title: Set document properties — set_document
code: set_document(   spec,   isContinues = NULL,   continuousSection = NULL,   contentWidth = NULL,   footnotePlace = NULL,   hasData = NULL,   topEmptyLine = NULL,   bottomEmptyLine = NULL,   docTemplate = NULL,   figureWidth = NULL,   figureHeight = NULL,   figureDevice = NULL,   figureScaleMode = NULL )

title: Set document properties — set_document
text: spec TFL spec object isContinues Logical. TRUE, titles subtitles shown first page multi-page spec instead repeating every page. Default FALSE (titles repeat page). continuousSection Logical. TRUE spec first report, page break spec suppressed continues page previous spec. Requires matching page size margins previous spec; differ, Word may still force page break. paginator adjusted — Word handles natural overflow content exceeds remaining page space. Works best short content (figures, text, small tables). Default FALSE. contentWidth Width content, e.g. "100%", "25cm", "10in", "600pt", "240mm" (units: %, , cm, mm, pt). footnotePlace Character; controls footnotes rendered. One "doc_footer" (place inside Word footer, footer rows), "repeated" (place table every page), "last_page" (place table last page ). Default "repeated". hasData Logical. Whether spec data render. Set TRUE tables data rows. FALSE, body text () rendered instead. topEmptyLine Empty spacer row height table header (table-level), e.g. "6pt". Use NULL disable. "0pt" treated spacer row. bottomEmptyLine Empty spacer row height table bottom border (table-level), e.g. "6pt". Use NULL disable. docTemplate Character. Template use rendering. Accepts either: Name bundled template (see tfl_list_templates()). Full path custom styles JSON file. figureWidth Figure width units, e.g. "6in", "70%", "16.51cm". relevant docType = "Figure". figureHeight Figure height units. syntax figureWidth. figureDevice Character. Image format used create_figure() renders ggplot2 object. One "cairo" (default; Cairo paths-SVG, MS Word-safe), "svg" (requires svglite; known render incorrectly MS Word — warns ), "png", "jpeg"/"jpg". chosen package-backed device unavailable, create_figure() falls back cairo -> svg -> png warning. figureScaleMode Character. figure scaled DOCX. One "fixed" (exact figureWidth x figureHeight; missing dimension inferred 6:4 default ratio), "fitWidth" (figure box stretched page content width, aspect ratio taken figureWidth/figureHeight — source image), "fitPage" (largest box aspect ratio fitting content area).

title: Rescan system fonts — tfl_rescan_fonts
text: Re-runs font discovery process using current value getOption("ksTFL.font_dirs"). useful installing new fonts changing ksTFL.font_dirs option.

title: Rescan system fonts — tfl_rescan_fonts
code: tfl_rescan_fonts()

title: Rescan system fonts — tfl_rescan_fonts
text: Invisibly returns font scan report (list resolutions dirs_scanned).

title: Rescan system fonts — tfl_rescan_fonts
text: point ksTFL custom TTF folder, set ksTFL.font_dirs option session, call tfl_rescan_fonts(): Multiple directories supported: package's bundled fonts directory always scanned automatically; ksTFL.font_dirs adds extra directories top . make setting persistent across sessions, add options() call ~/.Rprofile.
code: options(ksTFL.font_dirs = "/path/to/your/fonts") tfl_rescan_fonts() options(ksTFL.font_dirs = c("/path/to/fonts1", "/path/to/fonts2")) tfl_rescan_fonts()

title: Rescan system fonts — tfl_rescan_fonts
code: # Rescan after installing new fonts (prints the resolution summary) tfl_rescan_fonts() #> ksTFL font scan: 0 target(s) resolved, 6 using fallback #>   [fallback] Arial                -> Liberation Sans #>   [fallback] Times New Roman      -> Liberation Serif #>   [fallback] Courier New          -> Liberation Mono #>   [fallback] Georgia              -> Liberation Serif #>   [fallback] Verdana              -> Liberation Sans #>   [fallback] Trebuchet MS         -> Liberation Sans #>   Scanned 5 directories  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Point to a custom font directory, then rescan options(ksTFL.font_dirs = c("/usr/share/fonts/custom")) tfl_rescan_fonts() } # }

what: Reset all session options to package defaults — tfl_reset_options
title: Reset all session options to package defaults — tfl_reset_options
text: Restores ksTFL session options (headers, footers, body text, styles, page settings, column width behavior, etc.) original package defaults. Useful start new reporting session experimenting tfl_set_options().

title: Update the session package settings — tfl_set_options
text: Update ksTFL session options. function accepts: Named scalar options (e.g. contentWidth = "95%", missings = "."). Settings objects produced helper constructors add_header(), add_footer(), add_body_text(), page objects p_page(). mixture named values settings objects.

code: tfl_set_options(   ...,   docTemplate = NULL,   footnotePlace = NULL,   isContinues = NULL,   contentWidth = NULL,   missings = NULL,   figureWidth = NULL,   figureHeight = NULL,   figureDevice = NULL,   figureScaleMode = NULL,   autoColWidth = NULL,   minColWidth = NULL,   insertTOC = NULL,   tocTitle = NULL,   output_directory = NULL,   meta_directory = NULL )

title: Update the session package settings — tfl_set_options
text: ... Named arguments settings objects returned helper constructors. Named scalar options (e.g. contentWidth = "95%", missings = "."). Settings objects produced helper constructors add_header(), add_footer(), add_style(), add_body_text(), set_page_style(p_page(p_margins())). mixture named values settings objects accepted; function routes appropriate internal slot. docTemplate Character; name predefined bundled template (see tfl_list_templates(), e.g. "Default", "Navy_Pro") path external template JSON file. NULL (default) current session template left unchanged. Use tfl_reset_options() restore built-default ("Default"). Internally stored doc_style_template option (name returned tfl_get_options()). footnotePlace Character; controls footnotes rendered. One "doc_footer" (place inside Word footer, footer rows), "repeated" (place table every page), "last_page" (place table last page ). Default "repeated". isContinues Logical; override continuation behavior. contentWidth Character; width content area (e.g. "100%", "95%"). missings Character; default representation missing values (e.g. "", ".", "NA", "—"). Default empty string (""). figureWidth Character; default width figure output (e.g. "6in", "16cm"). Applied create_figure() specs specify width. figureHeight Character; default height figure output (e.g. "4in", "10cm"). Applied create_figure() specs specify height. figureDevice Character; graphics device used ggplot2 object rendered create_figure(). One "cairo" (default), "svg", "png", "jpeg"/"jpg" (values, e.g. "pdf", rejected). "cairo" exports paths-SVG via Cairo (text converted vector outlines) — MS Word-safe vector format; Word's SVG engine corrupts svglite text-SVG (font substitution, text-anchor px-scaling bugs), plain "svg" emits one-time warning. Cairo installed device falls back "svg" "png" warning. dpi ignored "cairo" (vector output). figureScaleMode Character; figures scaled page content area. One "fixed" (use figureWidth/figureHeight given; missing dimension inferred default 6:4 ratio), "fitWidth" (stretch content-box width using W/H-provided aspect ratio), "fitPage" (largest size aspect ratio fits remaining content area). Default "fixed". autoColWidth Logical; enable automatic column width recalculation user sets colWidth via define_cols(). Default TRUE. TRUE, locked columns maintain exact width unlocked columns normalize fill remaining space. Set FALSE disable auto-recalculation manage widths manually. minColWidth Numeric; minimum relative column width (%) unlocked columns recalculation. Default 0.5. code: # (options are session-global; examples restore defaults at the end) tfl_set_options(contentWidth = "95%", missings = ".") tfl_get_option("contentWidth")   # "95%" #> [1] "95%" tfl_get_option("missings")       # "." #> [1] "."  # Bundled template by name (see tfl_list_templates()); an external template # path works the same way: docTemplate = "/path/to/my_template.json" tfl_set_options(docTemplate = "Navy_Pro")  # Update page style via the helper objects tfl_set_options(   set_page_style(page = p_page(     size = "Letter", orientation = "portrait",     margins = p_margins(top = "1in", bottom = "1in",                         left = "0.75in", right = "0.75in"))) )  # Session-default header / footer / body text for every spec tfl_set_options(   add_header(c("Left Header", "Center Header", "Right Header")),   add_footer(c("Left Footer", "Center Footer", "Right Footer")),   add_body_text("This is the default body text for all text specs.") )  # Automatic column width recalculation (default TRUE): locking one # column re-normalizes the rest; FALSE keeps manually given widths. tfl_set_options(autoColWidth = TRUE) spec <- create_table(mtcars) |> define_cols(cyl, colWidth = "20%")  tfl_reset_options()   # back to package defaults  # TOC workflow: enable for the session, then tag titles with toclevel if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ tfl_set_options(insertTOC = TRUE, tocTitle = "List of Tables") spec <- create_table(mtcars) |> add_title("Table 1", toclevel = 1) write_doc(create_report(spec), "toc_demo", outDir = tempdir(),           metaPath = tempdir()) # In Word: click the TOC placeholder and press F9 to populate it. } # }

NULL (default), templates resolved per-spec spec's docTemplate value (allowing mixed templates multi-spec reports). provided name/path resolved, warning emitted Default used. font_dirs Optional character vector additional directories search fonts rendering. fallback_font Optional character string. code: # Basic end-to-end workflow (writes to tempdirs so it is self-contained) -- out <- file.path(tempdir(), "kstfl_out") meta <- file.path(tempdir(), "kstfl_meta") dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE); dir.create(meta, showWarnings = FALSE)  tbl <- create_table(mtcars) |>   add_title("Table 1: Motor Trend Car Road Tests")  doc_path <- write_doc(create_report(tbl), name = "mtcars_demo",                       outDir = out, metaPath = meta, verbose = FALSE) #> ✔ Report saved successfully #> ℹ Spec file: f78c5f8994855a8f.json #> ℹ Data files saved to: /tmp/RtmpCnw471/kstfl_meta #> ✔ DOCX rendered: /tmp/RtmpCnw471/kstfl_out/mtcars_demo.docx (1 page) #>   [OK] mtcars_demo -> /tmp/RtmpCnw471/kstfl_out/mtcars_demo.docx doc_path   # full path of the generated .docx #> [1] "/tmp/RtmpCnw471/kstfl_out/mtcars_demo.docx"  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Session defaults instead of per-call arguments -------------------------- tfl_set_options(output_directory = "output", insertTOC = TRUE,                 tocTitle = "List of Tables") write_doc(create_report(tbl), name = "mtcars_with_toc",           metaPath = file.path(tempdir(), "ksTFL_meta"), prettify = TRUE) } # }

text: Font registry thread-safety (font_scanner.h/.cpp): migrated std::shared_mutex; reader accessors take std::shared_lock return value, tfl_rescan_fonts() remains safe call renders run. (std::call_once rejected rescanning explicit user feature.) UTF-8 decoder validation (text_measurer.cpp): continuation byte now checked 10xxxxxx bits; malformed sequences decoder emits U+FFFD advances exactly one byte resync. Locale-independent numeric formatting (logical_table.cpp): apply_column_format() switched std::strtod std::from_chars<double>; column format parsing longer affected process locale. Column-width scaling precision (paginator.cpp): compute_segment_column_widths() performs arithmetic double clamps [0, INT64_MAX] narrowing int64 EMU. what: Internal C++ Engine — Safety, Performance & Modernisation
title: ksTFL 0.10.2
text: Exception-safe font loading (font_cache.cpp): load_face() now wraps hb_ft_font_create_referenced() try/catch block calls FT_Done_Face() rethrowing, preventing FreeType handle leak HarfBuzz construction failure. Eliminated redundant string lowering (font_cache.cpp, font_scanner.cpp): font_name_to_stem_hint() already returns lowercase string, second to_lower pass find_font_file() removed. TargetFallback structs now pre-compute target_lower field per-call lowering inside get_fallback_family() avoided entirely. -place style cascade application (style_resolver.h, style_resolver.cpp): new apply_style_ref_inplace(StyleDef &, const   std::string &) mutates target directly instead copy-merge-return. callers resolve_header_cell_style(), resolve_body_cell_style(), resolve_content_style(), resolve_body_text_style() resolve_figure_caption_style() converted -place variant, eliminating one StyleDef copy per style-ref application. Per-column base-style caches paginator (paginator.cpp): row loop compute_row_heights_impl now pre-computes base_style_cache addrow_style_cache (indexed column index) iterating rows, cutting repeated template-cascade merges (steps 1–5) one-time cost. style_ref_cache (std::unordered_map<std::string, const StyleDef*>) built per segment cache find_style() pointer lookups. requires std::invocable<…> constraint added template earlier type-checking. Pre-computed style caches DOCX table emission (docx_emitter.h, docx_table.cpp): emit_table() builds base_style_cache addrow_style_cache per segment passes emit_table_row(), now applies row/cell overrides top cached base instead recomputing full cascade every cell. Stack-allocated tag buffer (inline_parser.cpp): classify_tag() replaced heap-allocated std::string lower char lower_buf[8] stack buffer — tag names 3 characters, heap allocation needed per tag. std::format error messages (json_parser.cpp, renderer.cpp, font_cache.cpp): throw RenderError("…" + var + "…") patterns replaced std::format("…{}", var), removing temporary string concatenations (15 call sites total).

title: ksTFL 0.10.1
text: Style deep-merge across compute_cols() blocks: .append_style_action() longer removes entire multi-column style actions later block partially overlaps columns; overlapping columns surgically replaced, preserving styles non-overlapping columns. Combining styles share top-level category (e.g. two styles setting font properties) longer silently drops properties first style. Style application order preserved: ._consolidate_styles_in_spec() now merges styles order specified user (e.g. f_combine("", "b") applies first, b wins) instead sorting alphabetically. f_combine() accepted c_style(), c_merge(), c_addrow(): styleRef parameters row-action functions now accept multi-element style vectors produced f_combine(). .combine_column_styles() handles nested f_combine(): replaced .call(f_combine, ...) direct unlist() + class assignment correctly flatten style refs already contain multi-element vectors. compute_cols() accepts scalar TRUE/FALSE: scalar logical condition now recycled match nrow(data), allowing compute_cols(spec, TRUE, ...) shorthand “rows”.
